name: Footprint
desc: Arizona materials-science company making compostable fibre-based packaging as an alternative to plastic, with factories in the US and Mexico.
products: fibre food bowls and trays, paper straws, protective packaging
customers: Conagra Brands, Sweetgreen, Target, Philips, Bose, Foxconn
parent_ultimate: founders Troy Swope and Yoke Chung with investors
stores_or_sites: 135,000 sq ft Gilbert complex; plant in Mexicali; operations in Europe

alt_indicators.evidence: Conagra Brands, Target, Philips, Bose, Foxconn, Sweetgreen

signals.what: Footprint Center naming deal ended; stays a Suns/Mercury partner

fit_rationale: Sustainability-led packaging maker that used arena naming to sell plastic-free hospitality; F1's single-use-plastic goals and US races offer a showcase, but its listing status and finances are unclear.
outstanding: WATCH because ownership is unverified: the page reports a 2021 SPAC merger agreement (Gores Holdings VIII) without saying whether it closed; 1,500 employees is a 2020 figure

name: FORUM8
desc: Tokyo developer of civil-engineering design software and the UC-win/Road real-time VR and driving-simulator platform, title sponsor of WRC Rally Japan.
products: UC-1 design/CAD series, UC-win/Road 3D VR, driving simulators, dynamic and evacuation analysis software
customers: civil engineers, construction consultants, automotive and transport researchers
marketing_autonomy_basis: no listing shown; buys its own WRC title rights
stores_or_sites: offices in major Japanese cities; development base in New Zealand (since 1996)
markets: Japan, with development in New Zealand and international software sales
fit_rationale: Driving-simulator and VR software maker already paying WRC title rights in Japan; a Suzuka or simulator-technology tie-in fits, but revenue of USD 38m is below every route.
outstanding: WATCH: revenue USD 38m and 250 staff meet no route; shareholders not shown

name: Shyam Steel
desc: Kolkata family steel group making TMT reinforcement bars at an integrated plant in Durgapur, West Bengal, described as an INR 30 billion group.
customers: construction contractors, dealers and home builders in India
parent_ultimate: Beriwal family (founder Shriram Beriwal and Shyam Sunder Beriwala named as leaders)
stores_or_sites: integrated steel plant in Durgapur; plants in West Bengal
fit_rationale: Regional Indian rebar brand that used IPL shirt rights; no Indian Grand Prix and a domestic construction market make F1 a poor fit.
outstanding: WATCH: listing status not confirmed (must not be confused with listed Shyam Metalics); revenue year unknown

name: Grupo Akron
desc: Guadalajara-based Mexican lubricants and fuels group with two plants, a fuel terminal, 50+ service stations and exports to Central and South America.
products: 600+ lubricants, additives and greases; Akrontech gasoline; fuel storage; service-station franchises; Zona Akron workshops; Akron app
customers: motorists, workshops, transport, industrial and agricultural users
marketing_autonomy_basis: own brand; buys stadium naming rights
stores_or_sites: plants in Lagos de Moreno (Jalisco) and Tultitlán (Edomex); fuel terminal; 50+ service stations
markets: Mexico; lubricants exported to Guatemala, El Salvador, Honduras, Nicaragua, Costa Rica, Colombia, Ecuador, Peru, Bolivia, Venezuela; US petroleum supply

alt_indicators.evidence: lubricants and additives sold in about 10 Latin American countries plus US operations
10-year naming rights to Estadio Akron (Chivas, Zapopan) signed December 2017

fit_rationale: Mexican lubricant and fuel brand with a 2026 World Cup stadium name; the Mexico City Grand Prix and Latin American export markets suit a motorsport-led brand push.
category_conflict: potential: lubricants crowded in F1 (oil majors at several teams)
outstanding: WATCH: route met on indicators but owner and listing status not found on any page opened; no revenue or employee figure
discovery_source: t51 DISC (Liga MX sponsors: Akron Grupo)

name: Xtrac
desc: British engineering company designing and making gearboxes and driveline systems for F1, IndyCar, NASCAR, sportscars, rally and high-performance road cars.
products: racing gearboxes, 4WD systems, AMT transmissions (e.g. Pagani Huayra), hybrid transmission for LMDh, marine and aerospace drivelines
customers: motorsport teams and series (NASCAR sole gearbox supplier from 2022, LMDh, IndyCar), OEMs such as Pagani
stores_or_sites: 88,000 sq ft factory in Thatcham, Berkshire
markets: Global motorsport and performance automotive; US (NASCAR, IndyCar), Europe

alt_indicators.evidence: sole gearbox supplier to NASCAR (from 2022); hybrid gearbox supplier for LMDh; supplied F1 gearboxes to Lotus, Virgin and HRT (2010)

fit_rationale: Core motorsport transmission supplier whose customers are race teams and OEMs; better approached as a technical supplier than a sponsor, and any current F1 supply contract must be checked.
category_conflict: potential: may already supply F1 teams (page says it supplies 'F1' without naming current teams)
outstanding: WATCH: owner and listing status not on the page; no revenue or employee figure; check current F1 supply deals
